title_pt: Polícia de Ningxia apreende 21 aves em caso de caça ilegal
title_en: Ningxia police seize 21 birds in illegal-hunting case

card_text_en: Police seized one owl, seven ring-necked pheasants and 13 chukars, along with traps and other hunting equipment.
